title: Minimum Cost of Buying Candies With Discount
goal: Buy every candy at minimum cost when each paid pair can cover one no-more-expensive free candy.
strategy: Sort prices descending and process triples. Pay for the two most expensive remaining candies and make the third free, which uses each discount on the most valuable eligible candy.
